profile.text: Scioppa Razin, leader and commander-in-chief of the Ursine Independent Tactics Formation 'Sechin,' and leader of the Volniki. In early 1102, he led his unit out of the jurisdiction of the Ursine military. After the Deity Grypherburg Incident, 'Sechin' became fully independent. Later, through an introduction by a branch office operator, he began making contact with Rhodes Island on behalf of 'Sechin.'
